integrity: Theorem proved by complete orbit classification, exact formal-series inversion, and explicit equal-cardinality sharpness witnesses; computational checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The statement applies to uniformly q-element equivalence classes, pointwise named finite bases, and distinct fresh tuple coordinates. It does not recover fully named classes without the base size; historical priority is provisional. All-arity correctness follows from the proof, not from finite tests.
title: Sharp finite-arity recovery of marked bounded equivalence classes
